findings.review_positive_proof: A review-family PASS is safe only for a narrow fully enumerable policy subset. Missing requirement-dependent evidence is UNKNOWN, never inferred READY from approval rows alone.
findings.rest_pr_files_limit: REST pull-request file enumeration has a 3000-file service cap, so all-pages pagination does not prove changed-path completeness above that cap.
findings.stack_public_capability: Public GitHub stacked pull requests expose dedicated stack APIs and require asynchronous merge for stack merges; the contiguous bottom-through-requested stack merge is server-atomic at the group level.
findings.stack_exact_intent: Async merge sha/result bind the requested PR head, not an expected-head vector for every lower member. Exact-intent recovery therefore persists and revalidates ordered stack members plus their head/base SHAs in addition to the requested top SHA and async UUID.
findings.stack_queue: A large queued stack may span multiple consecutive merge groups; queue-stage evidence must support an ordered sequence of merge-group SHAs.
findings.connected_capability_gap: In the inspected connected GitHub surface, no stack-specific or async-merge action was discovered; generic /stacks fetch was allowlist-rejected and no caller-controlled API-version header was exposed. Legacy synchronous merge and auto-merge are not valid stack substitutes under GitHub's public stack contract.
